title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: masonry
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Basement blockwork walls
swms.task: Lay core-filled blockwork walls in the basement, cutting blocks with a brick saw, from mobile scaffolds and trestles.

facts.silicaControls: Blocks are cut wet or with on-tool dust extraction. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn by anyone still at risk. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.
facts.fallControl: Scaffolds and trestles over 2 m have full edge protection.
facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the mortar and grout are kept at the work area: alkaline, avoid skin contact, wear gloves and eye protection.

swms.title: Podium brickwork near slab edges
swms.task: Lay brickwork on the podium levels near the slab edges, with mortar mixed on site.

facts.fallControl: Edge protection with mesh infill stays in place at the slab edges.
facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the mortar are kept at the work area: alkaline, avoid skin contact, wear gloves and eye protection.

rules.phrase: Bricks and blocks are not engineered stone
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 529A, s 529B, s 529C
rules.quote: does not include ... (ii) bricks, pavers or other similar blocks

rules.phrase: Brace new walls until they are complete and cured
rules.source: Model Code: Construction work appendix F
rules.quote: Worker injured by structural collapse before completion & curing.
